name: Honda S65 / S90
engine: 63 or 89 cc air-cooled overhead-cam single, laid nearly flat, four-speed
intro: Honda's small sport singles of the 60s. A flat engine, a pressed-steel frame and six-volt electrics.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
